{"path":"logsummary.py","content":"from datetime import datetime, timezone


def build_summary(tool, started_utc, finished_utc, status, counts, errors) -> dict:
    """Build a summary dict from log run data."""
    started_dt = datetime.fromisoformat(started_utc.replace("Z", "+00:00"))
    finished_dt = datetime.fromisoformat(finished_utc.replace("Z", "+00:00"))
    duration_s = round((finished_dt - started_dt).total_seconds(), 2)

    exit_code_map = {
        "ok": 0,
        "partial": 1,
        "failed": 1,
        "precondition": 3,
    }
    exit_code = exit_code_map[status]

    return {
        "tool": tool,
        "schema_version": 1,
        "started_utc": started_utc,
        "finished_utc": finished_utc,
        "duration_s": duration_s,
        "status": status,
        "exit_code": exit_code,
        "counts": counts,
        "errors": errors,
    }
"}
